text:
Predicates:
Timeless(x) ::: x design style is timeless.
MassProduct(x) ::: x is a mass product design.
DesignStyle(x) ::: x is a design style.
Kelly(x) ::: x is Kelly Wearstler.
Evocative(x) ::: x design style is evocative.
Dreamy(x) ::: x design style is dreamy.
Max(x) ::: x is Max.
DesignBy(x, y) ::: x is designed by y.
Premises:
∀x (DesignStyle(x) → Timeless(zahaHadid)) ::: All of Zaha Hadid's design styles are timeless.
∀x (MassProduct(x) → ¬Timeless(x)) ::: No mass product design is timeless.
DesignStyle(zahaHadid) ∨ DesignStyle(kelly) ::: Either Zaha Hadid's design style or Kelly Wearstler's design style.
∀x (DesignStyle(x) → Evocative(kelly)) ::: All of Kelly Wearstler's design styles are evocative.
∀x (DesignStyle(x) → Dreamy(kelly)) ::: All of Kelly Wearstler's design styles are dreamy.
Timeless(designBy(max)) → (MassProduct(designBy(max)) ∧ Evocative(designBy(max))) ::: If a design by Max is timeless, then a design by Max is a mass product design and evocative.
Conclusion:
Evocative(designBy(max)) ∨ Dreamy(designBy(max)) ::: A design by Max is either evocative or dreamy.
